title: 5.3-magnitude earthquake strikes Nepal’s Koshi province: EMSC
html:
The quake was at a depth of 10km.

PHOTO: SCREENGRAB FROM EARTHQUAKE.USGS.GOV

KATHMANDU – An earthquake of magnitude 5.3 struck Koshi province in Nepal on Nov 24, the European Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said.

The quake was at a depth of 10km, EMSC said.

More to come. REUTERS
summary: The quake was at a depth of 10km, EMSC said.
